title: 怎樣做，便承受怎樣的結果
titleEn: As You Bake, So Shall You Brew
titleZh: 怎樣做，便承受怎樣的結果
imageAlt: Illustrated learning card for As You Bake, So Shall You Brew.
imageAltZh: 「怎樣做，便承受怎樣的結果」學習插圖。

source.reference: Oxford proverb index; original teaching scenes and questions

meaning.en: One’s choices and actions shape the consequences one must later face.
meaning.zh: 自己的做法會帶來相應後果，之後仍須面對或承擔。

formulas.formula: as you bake, so shall you brew
formulas.highlight: as you bake, so shall you brew

examples.en: The club failed to check the booking date and arrived to find the venue taken—as you bake, so shall you brew.
examples.zh: 社團沒有核對預訂日期，結果到場才發現場地已被別人租用。
examples.highlight: as you bake, so shall you brew

instructions.en: Choose the one sentence that keeps the situation’s facts and uses “as you bake, so shall you brew” accurately.
instructions.zh: 選出唯一保留情境事實、又正確使用「as you bake, so shall you brew」的英文句子。

questions.prompt: A club failed to check its booking date and arrived to find the venue taken.
questions.promptZh: 社團沒有核對訂場日期，到場才發現場地已租給別人。
questions.answer: The club’s unchecked date led to a lost venue—as you bake, so shall you brew.
questions.answerZh: 社團沒有核對訂場日期，到場才發現場地已租給別人。
